narrative:
A strong-looking individual was escorted to a platform. The individual slowly knelt before the king.

"Everyone in the kingdom will remember your adventure. Gaze upon this one, people! This adventurer here is our country's hero!"

With the king's decree, the crowd went wild. Ever since you witnessed the event with your own eyes, you dreamt of becoming an honorable adventurer, instead of inheriting your father's farm. Years have passed, and that dream still remains in your heart to this day. It finally motivated you to start your own adventure.

+ Gold, 10
+ Shortbow
+ Hide Armor

narrativeVariants.flags.sun_temple_destroyed == true:
A strong-looking individual was escorted to a platform, beneath the blackened, still-smoking ruin of what was once the Sun Temple. The crowd's cheers feel thinner than the old stories describe.

"Everyone in the kingdom will remember your adventure. Gaze upon this one, people!"

You grew up in the shadow of that ruin, and of the tales of the one who burned it. Years have passed, and your own dream of adventure still remains in your heart.

+ Gold, 10
+ Shortbow
+ Hide Armor
narrativeVariants.origin.royal == true:
A strong-looking individual was escorted to a platform. The individual slowly knelt before your father, the king.

"Everyone in the kingdom will remember your adventure. Gaze upon this one, people! This adventurer here is our country's hero!"

You watched from beside the throne, close enough to see the hero's hands shake. It was that day, not any lesson from your tutors, that taught you what House Aldric's name is actually worth to the people who kneel beneath it. Years have passed, and you mean to earn that name yourself, not just inherit it.

+ Gold, 10
+ Shortbow
+ Hide Armor
narrativeVariants.origin.vampire == true:
A strong-looking individual was escorted to a platform. The individual slowly knelt before the king, and you felt the crowd's heartbeat quicken around you like a single animal.

"Everyone in the kingdom will remember your adventure. Gaze upon this one, people!"

You have watched a hundred such ceremonies over the centuries, and worn a hundred different names doing it. This age's dream of adventure has crept into you again anyway. Some hungers never really fade.

+ Gold, 10
+ Shortbow
+ Hide Armor

narrative: The road out of your village splits at an old stone marker. To the west, smoke rises from the direction of a burned-out shrine the locals no longer speak of. To the east, a merchant caravan struggles to right an overturned cart.

narrative:
Your steady voice cuts through the panic. Within minutes the cart is upright, the goods secured, and the caravan master presses a few coins into your hand along with a word of thanks that spreads ahead of you on the road.

+ Gold, 5
+ Reputation with local merchants

Your attempt to organize the lift only adds to the chaos. A crate slips, and in the scramble a masked figure in the crowd lifts your coin pouch clean before vanishing down a side street.
